crossRefs.note: “The kings came and fought, then the kings of Canaan fought at Taanach by the waters of Megiddo. They took no plunder…
So it was, when Israel had sown, that the Midianites, the Amalekites, and the children of the east came up against them.
He went out and fought against the Philistines, and broke down the wall of Gath, the wall of Jabneh, and the wall of…
God helped him against the Philistines, and against the Arabians who lived in Gur Baal, and the Meunim.
Their enemies also oppressed them. They were brought into subjection under their hand.
He rescued them many times, but they were rebellious in their counsel, and were brought low in their iniquity.

people.name: Amalek
people.line: A nomadic people, descendants of Esau, enemies of Israel.

people.name: Maon
people.line: A city in Judah; home of Nabal and Abigail

translations.web: The Sidonians also, and the Amalekites, and the Maonites, oppressed you; and you cried to me, and I saved you out of their hand.
translations.bsb: Sidonians, Amalekites, and Maonites oppressed you and you cried out to Me, did I not save you from their hands?
translations.kjv: The Zidonians also, and the Amalekites, and the Maonites, did oppress you; and ye cried to me, and I delivered you out of their hand.
translations.asv: The Sidonians also, and the Amalekites, and the Maonites, did oppress you; and ye cried unto me, and I saved you out of their hand.
